findings.explanation: You are required to perform extra work requested by the client without any additional compensation, which can severely impact your profitability.
findings.suggested_change: The Contractor shall perform any additional services requested by the Client during the Term only upon agreement on a separate written change order and associated fees.

findings.quoted_text: Client may request unlimited revisions until Client is fully satisfied with each Deliverable.
findings.explanation: The client can demand an endless number of changes until they are personally satisfied, exposing you to open-ended time commitments for a fixed fee.
findings.suggested_change: The Client may request up to three rounds of revisions for each Deliverable, and any further revisions will be billed on a time and materials basis.

findings.explanation: The agreement specifies an unlimited revision allowance, which can require you to perform endless modifications without additional compensation.
findings.suggested_change: Revision allowance: Up to three rounds of revisions.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have a few small suggestions before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause about performing additional services at no additional charge, since uncompensated extra work can impact the project, I propose that: The Contractor shall perform any additional services requested by the Client during the Term only upon agreement on a separate written change order and associated fees. - Regarding the relevant clause allowing unlimited revisions until full satisfaction, as open-ended time commitments for a fixed fee can be difficult to manage, I propose that: The Client may request up to three rounds of revisions for each Deliverable, and any further revisions will be billed on a time and materials basis. - Regarding the relevant clause specifying an unlimited revision allowance, to ensure clarity on workload, I propose that: Revision allowance: Up to three rounds of revisions. Thank you for your time, and I look forward to finalizing this.
